rationale: The article's distinctive mechanism is preserving the EoS9 anchor while allowing only plausible, class-gated and budget-limited sidecar corrections. The existing six-block OOF-gate diagram communicates this more clearly than the much denser original cover and overall branch map. Rendered the standalone SVG to a temporary inspection PNG and checked complete 1600x900 viewBox: all blocks, arrows, title, and safeguards are inside the canvas, with large labels. Reuse the full unmodified SVG; no invented results and no cropped empirical data.
alt_en: Anchor and sidecar ranks pass a plausibility mask, class gate, and movement budget before acceptance.
